margin.phase_parameter: quadratic phase coefficient; endpoint extra phase .006 cycles at fixed linear parameters

router.fit: nearest standardized class centroid using ordinary iid/long_memory/narrowband only; training data independent; scale computed training only; reject outside max training class 95th percentile distance or nearest/second distance ratio > .8; unknown included in calibration
router.exam: first separate held-out router test, confusion matrix and high-risk routing of tangent/narrowband to iid; report per noise and missingness; no tuning after exam
router.oracle_controls: true family only diagnostic, never used by candidate

conditional.score: R4B9 local joint profile true drift score unchanged
conditional.groups: predicted route including unknown, no true family or true class supplied at inference; max 95% split conformal quantile across observed-route x actual generator stratum with >=20 calibration points; rare routes/strata use global maximum, any infinite quantile implies abstain
conditional.guard: use maximum of global and route-specific for unknown; route-specific for accepted known routes only; tangent and orthogonal included in calibration and evaluation; no claim of conditional distribution-free coverage of sparse intersections
conditional.grid: same R4B9 grid, no continuous confidence certificate
conditional.failures: missing scores included as infinity, fail closed for invalid grid
conditional.gate: each positive stratum >=90% correct DSS, <=5% ambiguous; each negative stratum <=5% DSS; truth inclusion >=90% per nonstationary stratum; exact mimic no scientific promotion

forecast.metric: local and final gap accuracy; measured estimator process time per call; no physical solver CPU savings inference

execution: router train then router exam; calibration uses frozen router artifact and hash; evaluation uses frozen thresholds and same router; forecast separate; retain scientific hold; no solver or production changes
